# Homesteader Labs

> Field-tested growing, foraging and off-grid reference for homesteaders, plus free tools that
> answer a question in plain words. Everything below is public and needs no account or key.
> We do not run client-side analytics, and the tools keep their data in the reader's browser.

Three reference endpoints return JSON and are safe to call directly. They are static and
immutable at the CDN, so they are cheap to poll and fast to read.

## Data endpoints

- [ZIP to USDA zone](https://homesteaderlabs.com/api/zone/06385/): `/api/zone/{zip}/` returns the
  hardiness zone for a 5-digit US ZIP, derived from the PRISM 2023 table. Not every ZIP is covered.
- [Frost normals by zone](https://homesteaderlabs.com/api/frost/6b/): `/api/frost/{zone}/` returns
  last spring and first fall frost as MM-DD, frost-free days, and the variance either side, from
  NOAA 1991-2020 normals aggregated to USDA zones. Zones 11a and warmer answer `frostFree: true`.
- [Pest emergence index](https://homesteaderlabs.com/api/pests/): `/api/pests/` lists covered
  crops; `/api/pests/{cropId}/` returns emergence thresholds (growing degree days or soil
  temperature) and evidence-rated companion plantings. Pests with no predictable emergence event
  carry `alertable: false` and a reason, so a notification built on this does not fire all season.
- [Data documentation](https://homesteaderlabs.com/data/): response shapes, sources, caveats, and
  how to attribute.

## What the data is and is not

- Frost normals are aggregated to USDA zones, which are keyed on winter minimum temperature, not
  on frost timing. Treat a zone-level date as a planning window, not a forecast for one address.
- Pest thresholds come from published extension sources and are cited per pest. Where a threshold
  is a fallback rather than a documented biofix, the record says so.
- We would rather answer "no data here" than return a plausible number. Absent records are absent
  on purpose.

## Tools

- [Planting calendar](https://homesteaderlabs.com/tools/planting-calendar/): zone-calibrated sowing
  and transplant dates, succession planting, season extension.
- [Weather and field indexes](https://homesteaderlabs.com/tools/weather/): frost probability, soil
  workability, growing degree days, catchment and solar.
- [Caloric security](https://homesteaderlabs.com/tools/caloric-security/): how much of a household's
  calories a plot can actually carry.
- [Crop knowledge base](https://homesteaderlabs.com/kb/): 340+ public-domain crop entries.

## Writing

- [Field notes archive](https://homesteaderlabs.com/archive/): first-person build logs and guides,
  including drip irrigation in raised beds, Meshtastic for property-scale comms, and growing garlic.

## Attribution

Cite as Homesteader Labs with the page or endpoint URL. If an assistant answers from this data,
a link back is the whole ask. Corrections and questions: contact@homesteaderlabs.com
